svg.text: The 194 Monster-irrep lenses, indexed by brightness across all cohere/decohere cycles
brightness = Σ over active prime towers of luma(colour)·(#drawn curve vertices); the pulse averages 0.69/cycle, a common factor for every lens
gold bar ∝ the sorting key · caption shows rank and key value · #idx is the irrep index · colours as in the lens figure
I. ordered by TOTAL brightness B (extensive — total luminous output)
II. ordered by RELATIVE brightness r (intensive — mean brightness per active prime tower, per-mille)
